claim_boundary.allowed_if_primary_passes: On the fixed component-clean retrospective train/dev split, task-relative raw-gap weighting improves parent-then-task macro sibling-ranking accuracy over both the otherwise identical binary Bradley-Terry TF-IDF critic and an exact-within-task-weight-multiset hash-permuted control, qualifying a separately named future-only prediction escrow.

inference_order: average pair credits within the logged decision parent/group
average logged decision-parent/group credits within task
evaluation.primary_estimand: dev task-macro logged-parent/group-macro unweighted pair accuracy differences; Improve parents are physical lineage parents, while cross-run Draft groups retain their released parent/group identity

binary_bt.fit: mirrored logistic regression with hard labels

gap_permuted_bt.fit: mirrored logistic regression using the exact gap_weighted_bt weight multiset within each task after an orientation-independent hash-ordered cyclic shift by one row
gap_permuted_bt.role: mandatory gap-information negative control; cannot be omitted or used as a rescue

gap_weighted_bt.fit: mirrored logistic regression with hard labels and task-mass-preserving sample weights
gap_weighted_bt.sample_weight: clip(gap_raw / train-task-q75, 0.25, 4.0), then divide by the mean clipped weight within each train task

stop_rules: Outer held-out test pair files and all prospective or score-channel truth paths are absent from every CLI and launcher.
No hyperparameter, transform, task pool, threshold, arm, metric, bootstrap unit, or claim may change after the first real model fit.
The true-gap arm must beat both binary_bt and gap_permuted_bt; gap_ridge, weighted secondary metric, Draft/Improve subgroup, or micro accuracy cannot rescue either failed contrast.
A pass only authorizes drafting a separately named pre-truth future prediction escrow; it does not alter any existing frozen future primary or authorize GPU replay.
A fail closes this exact gap-aware qualification on the current dev pool; no same-pool tuning or threshold search is allowed.

task_scale.definition: numpy linear/type-7 0.75 quantile of positive gap_raw within each train task
